findings.resolution: Date values are canonicalized and compared by timestamp; a distinct-Date regression test fails on divergence.
Replay consumption is measured by a private harness-owned journal cursor.
The declared synthetic fault seam reports escaped effects even when their values cancel.
Trusted and untrusted source nodes cannot claim derived provenance.
The generated containment oracle uses an independent iterative fixed-point calculation.
The release gate enumerates executable tests and independently spawns all clean/fault probes.
Node and INFER call records now use closed schemas and reject alternate fields, wrong shapes, and duplicate call ids.

scopeBoundary: Arbitrary unreported ambient authority is intentionally not claimed by S0. Structural interception and SES confinement are S1 and S2 concerns.
